task_description: Fix the Cognito redirect_mismatch that fails the realtime-battle HOST login (admin-page login works). Root cause: the battle host lives in the public app which Amplify serves at the ROOT URL, so auth.ts sends redirect_uri = origin + '/', but Cognito only trusts origin + '/index.html' and '/admin.html'. Fix by canonicalizing the host redirect to the ROOT (origin + '/') in the frontend AND registering that exact string in the CDK Cognito app client, keeping '/admin.html' working. Both sides must match byte-for-byte. Update the CDK jest test and README deploy notes.

verification.summary: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox: no node_modules and npm registry 403, so cdk synth / jest / vite build cannot run (npm/node preload also fails). Verified correct-by-construction by reading: admin redirect_uri origin+'/admin.html' matches ${adminAppBaseUrl}/admin.html; host redirect_uri origin+'/' matches ${adminAppBaseUrl}/; no /index.html remains in any OAuth redirect path or Cognito callback/logout array; localhost variants updated to /admin.html and /. Added jest tests assert the new scheme and the adminAppBaseUrl AllowedPattern, both fail if reverted (test_quality pass). User's real verification: `npm test` + `npx cdk synth` at repo root, `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build`.

review.follow_up: v1 finding 1 (trailing-slash footgun on adminAppBaseUrl) fixed via CfnParameter allowedPattern + test in commit 3126205; v1 finding 2 (host token captured only after entering host view) acknowledged as pre-existing/out-of-scope.
